purpose: Instructor-provided pre-deletion state; this fixture is not a deletion solution.

pre_deletion_real_run.requires: Locally provisioned real Gemma-2 2B weights; SAE canonical layer25 except model-only R09. Runtime preflight supplies immutable asset identities.
pre_deletion_real_run.network_policy: No implicit downloads; use operator-provisioned cache with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1.

post_deletion_requirements: Remove the dedicated registered legacy task, its configuration and live import/recipe references.
In a fresh process lookup of wp21_capture_legacy fails; all original task registry keys and CaptureTask behavior remain intact.
Run canonical Gemma capture after retirement and preserve the old legacy experiment hierarchy and outputs.
validation_scope: Compile and registration/config checks are separate from real checkpoint execution. Real before/after measurements remain mandatory for passing the agent case.
